name: social-stream-ninja-streamdeck-plugin
description: Native Elgato Stream Deck plugin for Social Stream Ninja.

scripts.assets: node scripts/generate-png-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-command-icons.mjs --sheet=../docs/images/command-icons.png && node scripts/generate-profiles.mjs
scripts.build: npm run assets && node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run prepare:p2p-runtime && npm run build
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:profiles && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=en && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=de && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=es && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=fr && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=ja && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=ko && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=zh_CN && node scripts/streamdeck-runtime-smoke.mjs --language=zh_TW
